# activedirectory_users (Data Source)

Search for users under a container by scope and filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Search for users under a container. filter_by terms are escaped for you and
# ANDed together; a raw ldap_filter is ANDed on top. Exceeding max_results is an
# error, never a silently truncated set.
data "activedirectory_users" "sales" {
  container = "OU=Sales,DC=corp,DC=local"
  scope     = "subtree"
  filter_by = {
    department = "Sales"
  }
}

output "sales_upns" {
  value = [for u in data.activedirectory_users.sales.users : u.user_principal_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `container` (String) SearchBase DN. Defaults to the domain root.
- `filter_by` (Map of String) Attribute equality terms, ANDed. Values are escaped for you.
- `ldap_filter` (String) Raw LDAP filter, ANDed with filter_by. You own its correctness.
- `max_results` (Number) Cap on results (default 1000). Exceeding it is an error, not truncation.
- `scope` (String) base, one_level, or subtree (default).

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Matching users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `account_expiration_date` (String) Account expiry (RFC 3339), or null if it never expires.
- `can_change_password` (Boolean) Whether the user may change their password.
- `change_password_at_logon` (Boolean) Whether the user must change password at next logon.
- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `dn` (String) The distinguished name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `given_name` (String) First name.
- `guid` (String) The objectGUID.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `name` (String) The user's name (RDN).
- `password_expires` (Boolean) Whether the password expires.
- `sam_account_name` (String) The sAMAccountName.
- `sid` (String) The security identifier.
- `surname` (String) Last name.
- `user_principal_name` (String) The UPN.
